aplQuery:
['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "maintenance: DBOS workflow retention complete"
| where ['attributes.batchFull'] == true
| summarize saturated_runs = count()
description: The DBOS terminal-workflow retention sweeper filled its 1,000-workflow batch for at least six runs in the last six hours. The sweeper may be healthy but behind. Inspect deleted/examined throughput and database capacity before changing TTL or batch size.
name: MoltNet DBOS retention backlog
